note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is thin on 684 of 694 records (`factory`, `generator`, `round`) while 10 later designed records add `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain` and `stack`, and `reward` carries four different key-sets, so the datasets-server infers the schema from `batch-r01.jsonl` and then cannot cast the later shards: `/is-valid` reports `preview` true but `viewer`, `search`, `filter` and `statistics` false, and `config-info` / `config-parquet` / `config-size` fail for `default`.

features.name: plan
features.note: present and non-empty on all 694 records, so it is declared as required rather than optional

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; 8 distinct key-sets across the 7 tool names `bash`, `read`, `write`, `edit`, `grep`, `fetch` and `pytest`

list.name: reflection
list.note: present on 280 of 11385 steps, spread over 124 of 694 records

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success`, `plan_changes`, `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on every record, plus `handoff` / `xfailed` on 289, `retries` on 7 and `duration_min` / `wasted_calls` on 4; four distinct key-sets in all

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain`, `stack` on the 10 designed records

disclosures.summary: Six records in `batch-r311.jsonl`, `batch-r312.jsonl` and `batch-r313.jsonl` are search-index rebuild/handoff leftover-mill episodes (Vespa, Elasticsearch, Whoosh `leftover3c`), not payment leftover-idempotency-key episodes. They are dest-stamped: each carries `meta.factory = payment-idempotency-factory` and `meta.generator = grok-4.6` exactly like the payment records, so no metadata field distinguishes them from the advertised payload. They are kept exactly as generated.

The other 688 records are payment leftover-idempotency-key episodes: 686 carry the `pay-` id prefix and two early records in `batch-r01.jsonl` carry the earlier `pid-` prefix. Both prefixes are advertised payload; only the `sir-` prefix marks the leftover mill.

disclosures: 138 records contain the phrase `leftover leftover leftover`. On 132 of them it is the advertised leftover-idempotency-key mechanic; the remaining 6 are the dest-stamped search-index records disclosed above.

`meta.kind` (always `episode`), `meta.seed`, `meta.designed`, `meta.domain` and `meta.stack` are present on only 10 records: the 6 dest-stamped `sir-` rows plus 4 designed payment rows in `batch-r346.jsonl` and `batch-r347.jsonl`. The other 684 records carry the thin `{factory, generator, round}` shape, and no record has a top-level `kind` field.
Every one of the 11385 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.

Two records in `batch-r76.jsonl` serialize their top-level keys in a different order (`steps` last). The field set is identical, and the declared schema matches by name, so the order carries no meaning.
